(NYSE:OWL) Class A common stock currently yields 5.8% based on their latest stock price and $0.90 annual dividend, which might be raised again next year, This 5.8% yield compares to 4.1% for the 10-year UST. content.title: Blue Owl Scraps Merger of Private Credit Funds After Selloff
content.description: Blue Owl Capital Inc. is calling off a merger of two of its private-credit funds after scrutiny over potential investor losses sent its shares tumbling. The firm terminated the deal between Blue Owl Capital Corp. and Blue Owl Capital Corp. II, citing current market conditions, and will re-evaluate its alternatives. Blue Owl's shares erased early gains on Wednesday in New York, on track for the lowest closing level since December 2023. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joined Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec on 'Bloomberg Businessweek Daily' to break it all down.

content.title: BLS isn't publishing Oct. jobs report, Kraken files for US IPO
content.description:
Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including the US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) announcing the October jobs report won't be released and data will be included in November's report due out December 16, crypto exchange Kraken (KRAK.PVT) filing confidentially for a US IPO, and Blue Owl Capital (OBDC) scrapping its merger of two of its private credit funds.

content.title: Blue Owl Scraps Merger of Private Credit Funds
content.description: Blue Owl Capital is calling off a merger of two of its private-credit funds, terminating the deal between Blue Owl Capital Corp. and Blue Owl Capital Corp. II, according to a statement Wednesday. The move comes after scrutiny over potential investor losses from the move sent its shares tumbling. Dani Burger reports on Bloomberg Television.
